Human Q6ZMQ8-1 V1232, human NP_004911.2 V1129, mouse Q80YE4 V1223, rat NP_001381515.1 V1229, rat XP_087490457.1 V1172. Q6ZMQ8-2 (446 aa) and Q6ZMQ8-3 (879 aa) contain no such motif
